# wordIzy

> Free word unscrambler, anagram solver, Wordle & Quordle solver with multi-language official Scrabble dictionaries. No sign-up required.

wordIzy is a comprehensive word game helper and solver platform supporting 9 languages. It uses official Scrabble dictionaries (NWL2023, CSW21, ODS9, FISE, Zingarelli, OpenTaal) as authoritative word sources. All word-list pages are server-side rendered for fast loading and SEO.

## Core Tools

- [Word Unscrambler](https://wordizy.com/): Enter scrambled letters and find every playable word, grouped by length and sorted by Scrabble score. Supports wildcards (? and *).
- [Anagram Solver](https://wordizy.com/anagram): Find exact anagrams using all provided letters.
- [Wordle Solver](https://wordizy.com/wordle): Solve Wordle puzzles with pattern matching and letter constraints.
- [Quordle Solver](https://wordizy.com/quordle): Solve 4 Wordle puzzles simultaneously.
- [Scrabble Duplicate](https://wordizy.com/scrabble): Find the best playable word from a Scrabble rack.
- [Wordfeud Helper](https://wordizy.com/wordfeud): Word finder optimized for Wordfeud tile values.
- [Random Word Generator](https://wordizy.com/random): Generate random valid Scrabble words with filters.
- [Dictionary Lookup](https://wordizy.com/dictionary): Check word validity, get definitions, phonetics, and Scrabble scores.
- [Anagram Blitz Game](https://wordizy.com/blitz): 60-second word unscramble game with daily challenges and infinite practice mode.

## Word Lists

- [Words Starts With A-Z](https://wordizy.com/wordstarts): Browse all Scrabble words starting with each letter.
- [Words Ends With A-Z](https://wordizy.com/wordends): Browse all Scrabble words ending with each letter.
- [Unscramble by Length](https://wordizy.com/wordlists): Browse words by length, 2 to 15 letters.
- [Wordle Words Starts A-Z](https://wordizy.com/wordle-starts): Browse Wordle words starting with each letter.
- [Wordle Words Ends A-Z](https://wordizy.com/wordle-ends): Browse Wordle words ending with each letter.

## Guides

- [Best Wordle Starter Words](https://wordizy.com/guides/best-wordle-starter-words): Mathematically optimal opening words, strategies, and a second-guess framework.

## Languages Supported

English, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, German, Dutch, Japanese (Romaji), Chinese (Pinyin)
